summary: The filing is an 8-K by TLGY Acquisition Corp, a SPAC, reporting a one-month extension of its initial business combination deadline from May 17, 2026 to June 16, 2026. The sponsor deposited $10,000 into the trust account to effect the extension as permitted under the company's charter. This is a routine ticking-clock extension, not a definitive deal or strategic event. The extension is standard for SPACs unable to complete a combination within the initial timeframe, providing additional time to identify or close a target. There are no deal terms, premium, or break fees. What to watch: whether an acquisition is announced before the new June 16 deadline or if the SPAC liquidates.
